programmes.amount_note: Investment incentives comprising cash grants, leasing subsidies, wage subsidies and tax exemptions; aid intensity follows the regional aid map and company size, with the highest rates for small enterprises.

Tender Opening Board review, then presentation to the Tender Evaluation Board
Register a company in Greece before signing the incubation contract

Bank assesses creditworthiness and innovation criteria and signs the guaranteed loan

eligibility.other_note: Existing and start-up micro, small and medium enterprises that meet at least one innovation eligibility criterion and are creditworthy; not for refinancing existing loans.

programmes.source_snippet: combining, for the first time, the provision of a loan guarantee and a grant of up to 20% of the loan capital
